reviews.title: Poor connection

reviews.title: Poor visibility into system
reviews.text: I use this app to attempt control my pools at my Airbnb remotely. I thought this would be an easy way to quickly adjust temperatures for guests. I’ve had nonstop issues with the pool either not heating, people flipping off the heater switch and having no idea what’s happening with my pool, or the app saying the pool is being heated when it isn’t. the app doesn’t show any sort of history of temperature so I can’t troubleshoot and there is zero diagnostic support. Also, why can’t I set a time & date range for the heat, just like the schedule?

reviews.title: Sucks
reviews.text: Doesn’t work most of the time

reviews.title: Owner
reviews.text: App is terrible. Consistently disconnects from my Wi-Fi requiring me to go cycle power on my entire pump house. The app has no proper dashboard. You have to click between the web and the app. Schedules don’t work because they tell you the times for starting stop the same but they aren’t. Multiple names for pump just to name a few. Please pay somebody to create a proper app it gives a user a good experience

reviews.title: App loses connection non stop
reviews.text: One of the more frustrating apps I have for the house. It constantly loses connection despite everything else being able to connect properly.

reviews.title: Seen better controls
reviews.text: My previous Pool I had a Hayward control system. It had better options to control your Pool than Aqua Link. One specific thing I really miss on this app versus the Hayward app. The ability to control my pumps with timers.

reviews.title: Could be so much better…
reviews.text: Use this to control only my Polaris FREEDOM cleaner robot. Understandably the robot has limited modes from its on-board controls, but in the app you run a special hybrid mode. I’d like more control here. For instance the floor cleaning mode runs for like 1:30 but the SMART Cycle runs for 1:39. This time of year with leaves falling I want the floor cleaning to run for as long as it possibly can. Just give me the option to run until you’re about to die and I’ll worry about fishing it out with the hook when it’s done.

reviews.title: Not consistent
reviews.text: System constantly needs attention. I have to fight regularly with getting the hub to connect and hold a WiFi signal. It’s really frustrating. I have great internet and even have extend internet access throughout my home, the hub still drops connection. It take multiple attempts over days sometimes to get it up and running again.

reviews.title: No flexibility with words!
reviews.text: I have a chill pool but can’t change the wordage to say chill! I have a dual energy source both gas and electric which uses my solar power. Can’t change those words either. Please fix this! Happy to give 5* then!

reviews.title: Connectivity is terrible

How about you upgrade your system.  We have tried everything, including hard wiring, replacing the antenna and it still is constantly offline.  Every now and again it will pop up online and as soon as you try to use it, it immediately goes off line.  An expensive mistake.

reviews.title: The Worst!
reviews.text:
This is quite possibly the worst app I have on my phone. Actually, it is. The number of times I have to refresh the application for it to connect to. My system is unbelievable. I have just spent five minutes trying to get my spa turned on through the app and I’m still not done. I’ve got the blower and I’ve got spa mode on, but I can’t get the heater to turn on. Don’t even get me started if you want lights. It is truly awful and the customer service experience is not any better when you try to troubleshoot.

Asking me to reduce the security of my network (remove any special characters from my password) is not a solution.

reviews.title: No push alarms
reviews.text: We live in the middle of New Hampshire and keep our pool running all winter long. It is important that the pool temperature stay at 75° or higher. There have been occasions where the Janni interface board glitched and went off-line. At that point both the pump and the heater also went off-line. There’s no warning of this.  It is reasonable to expect an application to send you some type of push notification when alarms, criteria, set points are hit.  This application doesn’t do it and it would not take very much programming to put it in place. Buyer beware. If you’re counting on this app to let you know that there’s a problem, it will not do it unless you manually check it yourself.

reviews.title: Absolute Junk. Updated
reviews.text:
This software is very poorly designed . Connection to the pump controller is very intermittent and half the functions they say are available are missing. E.g. when you have a direct wifi connection to the pool pump controller you are supposed to be able set up the pump schedule etc. But you cannot do this as it goes straight to the screen to connect to your router and  WiFi network and you never get the pump control screen. 

**********************************
“Update: this does not work as per the instructions it requires you to skip the setup option given when your phone connects directly via wifi. Bluetooth option mentioned in the instructions does not exist!
***********************************
Also most of the time it will not connect to my WiFi network even though it is a very strong signal and my phone has no problem connecting.

***********************************
Update: I had already followed all the advice given by the technicians in on line documentation and on line info prior to posting but they eventually got it working after I called them. It appears that there were two issues:

1. The pump controller has difficulty connecting to mesh networks even if the 5GHz network is turned off. Solved by connecting to the slower Guest network.

2. Backend issues  caused by company servers and user ids.

Now working although it still goes off line regularly (LAN stays connected but WAN disconnects) but seems to come back eventually.
